title: Sample preparation and imaging procedures for fast and multiplexed superresolution microscopy with DNA-PAINT-ERS
protocol: Suspend DS oligos in ultra-pure water for a 1 mM concentration.
Combine 20 µl of DS oligo (1 mM), 19 µl of ultra-pure water, and 8.5 µl of freshly made 1M NaHCO3.
Vortex the mixture, then add 2.5 µl of desired DBCO-PEGx-NHS ester linker.
Vortex again and run reaction for 3 hours at room temperature with gentle shaking.
Add 500 µl of 100% EtOH and 50 µl of 3M sodium acetate, vortex, then leave in -80°C overnight.
Spin for 30 min at ~20,000 g at 4°C.
Remove supernatant, add 500 µl ETOH, vortex, and spin for 5 min at ~20,000 g in 4°C. Repeat 3 times.
After the last wash, remove supernatant and add 50 µl of ultra-pure water, 100% EtOH and 50 µl of 3M sodium acetate. Vortex, then leave in -80°C overnight.
Repeat DNA centrifugation and purification once as described earlier.
Measure DS-PEG concentration with NanoDrop UV-Vis spectrophotometer and record ratio of absorbance values at 260 nm (for DNA) and 495 nm (for 6-FAM) or 550 nm (for Cy3™).
Mix 100 µl of antibody with 10 µl of freshly made 1 M NaHCO3.
Add azido-PEG4-NHS in 100x molar excess.
Vortex and run reaction for 3 hours at room temperature with gentle shaking.
Flow antibody-PEG4-azide conjugates through a 50 kDa size exclusion column.
Wash with PBS 15 times on the column via centrifugation.
Centrifuge at 4°C, 6000 g, 2.5 minutes each spin.
Add DS-PEGx-DBCO in 5x molar excess to the antibody-azide conjugate.
Vortex and run reaction overnight at room temperature with gentle shaking.
Add 0.1% sodium azide to quench reaction (at ~1:10 v/v ratio to the reaction mixture).
After one hour, flow antibody-DS conjugates through a 100 kDa size exclusion column.
Wash with PBS 5 times on the column via centrifugation.
Centrifuge at 4°C, 6000 g, 2.5 minutes each spin.
Measure antibody concentration with NanoDrop UV-Vis spectrophotometer.
Reconstitute CF®660R Succinimidyl Ester stock at 10 mg/ml in DMSO.
Store aliquots of dye stock at -80°C.
Add 5 µl of IS oligo (1 mM) to 40.5 µl of freshly made 0.1 M NaHCO₃ solution.
Vortex the mixture and add 4.5 µl of dye (10 mg/ml).
Run reaction for 3 hours at room temperature with gentle shaking.
Add 500 µl of 100% EtOH and 50 µl of 3M sodium acetate to the reaction mixture.
Vortex the solution and leave it in -80°C overnight.
Spin the mixture for 30 min at ~20,000 g at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and add 500 µl ETOH. Vortex and spin for 5 min, ~20,000 g, 4°C.
Repeat washing step three times.
After the last wash, remove supernatant and dry pellet.
Add 20 µl of ultra-pure water to the final product.
Measure IS concentration with NanoDrop UV-Vis spectrophotometer.
Calculate DOL using absorbance values at 260 nm and 660 nm.
Maintain U2OS cells in Gibco DMEM + 10% FBS.
Passage U2OS cells every three to four days.
Grow cells overnight on 8-well chambered coverglass in phenol red-free DMEM.
Wash cells with PBS 1x for immunostaining of clathrin or caveolin.
Fix cells with cold 3.7% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in 1x PHEM buffer.
Wash cells with PBS twice.
Quench cells with 0.1% sodium borohydride in PBS for 7 minutes.
Wash cells with PBS three times.
Permeabilize cells with 0.5% saponin in PBS for 20 minutes.
Fix cells with 3.7% PFA and 0.1% glutaraldehyde (GA) in 1x PHEM for 20 min for microtubule staining before quenching and permeabilization in 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS.
Quench cells with sodium borohydride after fixation for microtubules.
Permeabilize cells with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS for 20 minutes for microtubule staining.
Block cells in 5% BSA in PBS for 30 minutes on a gentle rocker.

Incubate cells with primary antibodies for clathrin, caveolin, or tubulin antibody (0.5 mg/mL or 1:200 dilution from stock) in PBS buffer containing 3% BSA and 5% salmon sperm DNA on a rocker at room temperature for 1 hour.
Wash cells with PBS three times, each for 5 minutes.
Incubate cells with DS-conjugated secondary antibody at a final concentration of ~8 µg/ml in PBS buffer containing 3% BSA and 5% salmon sperm DNA.
Incubate the solution on a rocker at room temperature for 1 hour.
Wash with PBS three times, each wash lasting 5 minutes.
Pre-permeabilize cells with cold 0.1% Triton X-100 in 1x PHEM buffer for 45 seconds.
Fix cells with 3.7% PFA in 1x PHEM for 20 minutes.
Wash cells twice with PBS.
Quench with freshly made 0.1% sodium borohydride in PBS for 7 minutes.
Label cells with beta-tubulin as described earlier and postfix with 3.7% PFA for 10 minutes.
Stain co-labeled samples for clathrin as described earlier.
Post-fix all cell staining procedures with 3.7% PFA and 0.1% GA in 1x PHEM for 10 minutes.
Add 150 µl of 2.5% 50 nm gold particles in PBS+ to cells for 10 minutes.
Wash cells with PBS.
Add imaging buffer containing Buffer C (500 mM), ethylene carbonate, and IS-CF660R at a final concentration of 1-2 nM.
Turn on the microscope, lasers, and EMCCD camera.
Select a 60x Apochromat TIRF objective with 1.49NA and mount the sample using index matching oil.
Open the laser shutter and bring the sample to focus.
Adjust the TIRF angle for the desired penetration depth.
Set the initial exposure time (30-50 ms), laser power (~500 W/cm²), and EMCCD gain (200-300).
Adjust parameters as necessary based on single-molecule brightness and localization kinetics.
Engage the auto-focus system and start acquisition using micro-manager or another acquisition software.
Extract localizations, sorting, and rendering using in-house Matlab scripts.
